name: Murder On The Island
source:
Murder on the Island is a Visual Novel story, which takes place on a beautiful tropical island, where one of the 14 vacationers found murdered.
Paul Parker, the owner of the island has only one week to find out what happened on the first night, before the killer can get away with the scheduled boat service.
Can he solve the mystery? Find out yourself!
translation:
《Murder on the Island》是一部發生在美麗熱帶島嶼上的視覺小說。14名前來度假的人中，有一人被發現遭到謀殺。
島主保羅．帕克只有一週時間，必須趕在兇手乘坐定期船班逃走之前，查清第一晚究竟發生了什麼。
他能解開謎團嗎？答案由你親自揭曉！
